sourceContract: transparent isolated whole-asset panels; opaque reserved green calibration squares retained in source
normalization: Measure intact floor width and center separately in each isolated panel. Uniformly scale 128/measuredWidth and translate floor center to (96,248); never scale from alpha bounds or fit foot positions. No axis stretching.
panelExtraction: Strict known guide panels first. If actual art only protrudes into planned gutters, inspect and allow bundled alpha-seam recovery only when whole transparent separator exists; retain original failure. Never clip touching art.
processingCommand: python SKILL_DIR/scripts/tile_tools.py process-on-floor source-01.png guide.json processed --min-alpha 32 --registration floor-width
limitations: AI geometry and nominal anatomy height are design targets, not certified geometry. Mixed chroma edges are approximate. Report any processing failure with sources intact.
